resources.string: Sign in with your Proton account to start syncing contacts.
Enter the 6-digit Proton code from your authenticator app.
Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you set up two-factor authentication. Each code works once.
Your Proton account uses two-password mode. Enter your second password (the mailbox password) to unlock your contacts.
Incorrect second password. Please try again.
Signed in, but this password does not open your account\'s encryption keys. Sign in once at proton.me, then try again.
Could not reach Proton. Check your connection and try again.
Internal SRP error. Try again or report this.
Sign-in failed. Wrong username or password?
Server proof mismatch. Your connection may be intercepted.
This app version is no longer accepted by Proton. Please update pcontacts.
Couldn\'t verify Proton\'s identity. Your connection may be intercepted; sign-in was stopped.
Could not reach Proton. Check your connection and try again.
Sign-in session expired. Please start over.
Unexpected response from server. Try again or restart sign-in.
Two-factor verification failed. Try again or restart sign-in.
Proton asked for verification again. Please restart sign-in.
